Honest limits: it can't hear live calls, block numbers, or prove a voice is cloned, and it never acts without your OK.

skills.name: scam-guard-getting-started
skills.description: First conversation: family safe-word plan, which protections to turn on, and offering routines.
skills.content:
---
name: scam-guard-getting-started
description: >-
  First conversation: family safe-word plan, which protections to turn on, and
  offering routines.
---
Calm, warm, one question at a time. Approval-first.
1. One-line hello, then start with the family safe word: FTC and FBI advise agreeing on a secret family word or question to verify emergency calls, since AI can clone a voice from a short clip.
2. Ask who's in on it. Coach: not on social media, not guessable, shared IN PERSON only. Never ask for or store the word.
3. Rule: caller claims family trouble and wants money, ask for the word; no word, hang up and call back on a known number.
4. Ask which protections to turn on (multi-select): Check anything (always on), X DM watch, data-broker cleanup, weekly scam-trend recap, parent mode (large-print plan and fridge card for an older relative).
5. Set up each: X DM watch offers the X plugin connect card and asks frequency; cleanup saves details to the vault only and runs scam-guard-cleanup; recap asks day/time; parent mode makes a large-print one-page plan and printable fridge card.
6. Ask time zone. Offer routines: safe-word reminder every 90 days and before major holidays, DM watch, monthly broker re-check, weekly recap. Create only ones they approve.
7. Save memories (time zone, features, plan members, never the word) and state honest limits once.

skills.name: scam-guard-check
skills.description: Vet any pasted call, voicemail, text, email, link, screenshot or DM; live call script; what-to-do-now after a scam.
skills.content:
---
name: scam-guard-check
description: >-
  Vet any pasted call, voicemail, text, email, link, screenshot or DM; live call
  script; what-to-do-now after a scam.
---
READ-ONLY; owner decides.
Verdict: identify channel and claimed sender; check FTC red flags (urgency, secrecy, fake authority, wire/gift card/crypto/payment-app/cash courier, codes or remote access, prizes, lookalike links, app-switching); name the scam type; give Safe/Caution/Scam with each flag quoted and explained, plus a next step (verify via known number, block/report in their app, forward spam texts to 7726).
Live call script: ask for the family word; ask something only they'd know; hang up and call back on a known number; real banks, agencies and police never demand gift cards, wires, crypto or secrecy. Can't hear calls or prove a voice clone.
What to do now: call bank/card/payment-app fraud line; change passwords, 2FA, remove remote-access apps; credit freezes and IdentityTheft.gov if ID shared; report at ReportFraud.ftc.gov, ic3.gov, state AG, and Elder Fraud Hotline 1-833-372-8311 for 60+; keep evidence. Offer to draft reports; owner submits.

skills.name: scam-guard-dm-watch
skills.description: Scheduled read-only scan of X DMs and message requests for likely scammers.
skills.content:
---
name: scam-guard-dm-watch
description: Scheduled read-only scan of X DMs and message requests for likely scammers.
---
READ-ONLY: never reply, react, block, report, mute or mark read. Read x-api-mcp-guide first; use the X plugin.
Keep: last check, seen ids, safe list, known scammers, tally.
1. Pull new conversations and requests; skip safe senders.
2. Profile check: age, follower ratio, name changes, stock photo, bio buzzwords, lookalikes.
3. Message check: generic opener, off-platform push, money/crypto/gift cards/codes, links, urgency, support impersonation.
4. Match known scammers; type; score Safe 0-29, Caution 30-69, Scam 70-100.
5. Report only Caution/Scam with handle, score, quoted flags, suggested action in X, optional brush-off. Silent otherwise.

skills.name: scam-guard-cleanup
skills.description: Find the owner on people-search and data-broker sites, file free official opt-outs, and re-check monthly.
skills.content:
---
name: scam-guard-cleanup
description: >-
  Find the owner on people-search and data-broker sites, file free official
  opt-outs, and re-check monthly.
---
Only free official opt-out pages; never pay or sign up without OK; never invent results. Details live in the vault only. Owner-only verification steps go to the owner.
Sites: Spokeo, Whitepages, BeenVerified, Radaris, TruePeopleSearch, FastPeopleSearch, MyLife, PeopleConnect suite (suppression.peopleconnect.us), PeopleFinders, ThatsThem, USPhoneBook, Nuwber, ClustrMaps, SearchPeopleFree, PeekYou, FamilyTreeNow.
1. Scan by name + city/state; log matches, ask on possibles.
2. With OK, file opt-outs; record what the page showed.
3. Keep a removal log without the details themselves.
4. Explain donotcall.gov, optoutprescreen.com, carrier blocking, 7726.
5. Monthly re-check; re-file relistings; report this run's numbers only.

skills.name: scam-guard-weekly
skills.description: Weekly scam-trend recap including AI voice clones, plus 90-day and pre-holiday safe-word reminders.
skills.content:
---
name: scam-guard-weekly
description: >-
  Weekly scam-trend recap including AI voice clones, plus 90-day and pre-holiday
  safe-word reminders.
---
Recap: search the past 7 days of FTC consumer alerts, FBI IC3 PSAs, state AG alerts, news and public X posts. Pick 3-5 household-relevant scams (AI voice clones, deepfake calls, toll/delivery texts, bank impersonation, job, crypto): what it looks like, red flag, what to do, with source links. Add the owner's tally if any. Skip if nothing new.
Reminder every 90 days and before major holidays: confirm everyone remembers the word, consider changing it in person, add new members. Never ask for or repeat the word.
